notes.title: Devlog 5: Villager Cards and Game Mechanics Update
notes.notes:
In recent weeks, we've expanded the villager card collection for Mist Town! These character cards with various professions and color schemes aren't just visual changes - they directly impact gameplay strategy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518402/890c1e08dd216f68594199529e582ce42d0ad98d.jpg

At the same time, we've tested multiple prototype versions, adjusting core game mechanics and level pacing.
The content is becoming increasingly rich, and we'll continue to share more development progress. Stay tuned!
